description: This Java class defines settings for serializing JSON responses in API calls within the Fineract framework. It encapsulates various options such as partial responses, templates, and inclusion of JSON, providing methods to instantiate and query these settings.

classes.name: ApiRequestJsonSerializationSettings
classes.description: A class to encapsulate settings we allow on API that affect how JSON is to be serialized for the response to API call.

methods.name: from
methods.description: Static factory method to create an instance of ApiRequestJsonSerializationSettings with specified parameters.

methods.name: isPartialResponseRequired
methods.description: Instance method to determine if a partial response is required based on parameters.
